name: Act I map smoke — teleport every registered map

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const maps=window.__MAPS||[];const out=[];for(const id of maps){const beforeErr=(__DQ.errors||[]).length;try{const t=__DQ.teleport(id);await sleep(900);for(let i=0;i<6;i++){__DQ.press('cancel',30);await sleep(40);}const st=__DQ.state();const p=st.player||{};out.push({id,ok:!!(t&&t.ok),map:st.map&&st.map.id,scene:st.scene,x:p.x,z:p.z,y:p.y,errs:(__DQ.errors||[]).length-beforeErr,colliders:st.map&&st.map.colliders,props:st.map&&st.map.props});}catch(e){out.push({id,ok:false,error:String(e)});} }window.__SMOKE=out;return JSON.stringify({n:out.length,fail:out.filter(o=>!o.ok||o.map!==o.id||o.errs>0),all:out});})()

steps.msg: every map teleports clean with matching id and no new errors
